facts.business: NDTV is a media company operating a diversified portfolio of news brands including NDTV 24x7 (English), NDTV India (Hindi) and NDTV Profit (Business), supported by a growing digital network, delivering credible journalism across television and digital platforms.

auditor.name: Intertek India Pvt. Ltd.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 42 regarding Scheme of Amalgamation between the Company and its subsidiaries (NDTV Networks Limited, NDTV Worldwide Limited, NDTV Media Limited and NDTV Labs Limited) effective from 01 October 2025, accounted for under Ind AS 103 with comparative financial information restated.

key_risks: Monetisation imbalance with high dependence on advertising models and pressure on subscription pricing
Fragmented attention economy making sustained engagement harder and increasing content discovery challenges
Low willingness to pay outside premium video limiting revenue diversification
Measurement and attribution complexity affecting advertiser confidence and full-funnel ROI tracking
High content investment risk with rising content costs and unpredictable consumer preferences
Tax loss carry forwards of Rs 1,312.84 million not recognized due to uncertain future profitability
facts.related_party_note: Scheme of Amalgamation between the Company and its subsidiaries (NDTV Networks Limited, NDTV Worldwide Limited, NDTV Media Limited and NDTV Labs Limited) effective from 01 October 2025, approved by Regional Director (Northern Region), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Delhi. Investment in Awani reclassified as other equity instruments measured at FVTPL after 2.31% dilution in equity shareholding due to issuance of shares to Astro Entertainment Sdn. Bhd. Company disputed this transaction but reclassified conservatively without prejudice to rights to seek restoration of original 20% shareholding.
